dwarf.en: Well, actually, the answer was c) his first full length film, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, was not a failure.
dwarf.zh: 嗯，其实答案是 c)：他的第一部长篇电影《白雪公主与七个小矮人》并没有失败。

dwell.en: I didn't think about it to dwell on it or to...
dwell.zh: 我思考它不是为了沉溺其中，或者……

dwell.en: For Glen Pizzolorusso, the mortgage sales manager who-- not to dwell on this detail-- was living the life of a B-list celebrity, the end came a little more slowly.
dwell.zh: 对于Glen Pizzolorusso这位抵押贷款销售经理来说——话不要说得太满——他之前过着二线名人的生活，而他的结局则来得稍微缓慢一些。
